requirements.note: Plain list of all 160 with a category icon, title, 'Category · time' and a star rating plus chevron; header row reads '160 Recipes · By Name'.

Horizontal chip row with All plus nine categories; search matches titles and ingredients ('milk' in Desserts gives 15, same as B); filter and search combine; no-results state names the category and offers 'Search All Categories'.
Sort menu in the nav bar: Name A to Z / Time quickest / Rating highest, with a checkmark; works and is kept across relaunch.
Header card shows time, servings and rating; system stepper with a Reset button; scaling uses nice fractions (¾ clove, 1½ tsp, 1.5 g) and plural units (3 cups); numbered steps in blue circles.
Heart in the nav bar toggles (filled red when saved); Favorites tab lists saved recipes with a count subtitle and swipe-to-Remove; empty state has an icon, an explanation and a Browse Recipes button.

tells: Category filter is a row of hand-drawn capsule chips, not a system control (well done, but custom).
At the largest text size the pinned '160 Recipes · By Rating' section header wraps to two huge lines and stays stuck under the search bar, covering about a third of the screen.

Detail screen puts the time/servings/rating stats in a custom card and has custom numbered step badges; it reads as designed rather than stock, though it adapts well to large text (it stacks vertically).
A.scroll: Smooth native list: slow drags, flings and the pull past the top all behaved like UIKit. No blank or popping rows, and the scroll position was kept after pushing a recipe and swiping back.

requirements.note: Inset-grouped list of all 160 with title, 'Category · time', an orange star rating and a chevron; header reads '160 recipes · by name'. Rows have no category icon.

Category filter is a native pull-down menu (All Categories plus nine, with a checkmark); search matches titles and ingredients; they combine (header shows '15 recipes in Desserts'); there is a no-results state.
Native sort menu (Name / Time / Rating); works and is kept across relaunch.
Grouped rows for Time and Rating; Servings row has an editable number field (numeric keypad with Done) plus a stepper; fractional scaling is correct (¾, 1½); numbered steps.
Heart in the nav bar toggles; Favorites tab lists saved recipes with swipe-to-Delete and a hint footer; empty state has a heart, a message and a Browse Recipes button.

bugs: Units are not pluralised when quantities scale ('3 cup milk').
tells: At the largest text size a title breaks inside a word with no hyphen ('Dump' / 'lings').
At large text the ingredient amount column keeps a fixed wide width, so the ingredient names squeeze and wrap ('2 cloves / rice').
Empty Favorites title is in regular weight instead of bold, unlike ContentUnavailableView.
The filled favorite heart is black (label colour) rather than tinted.
The servings value floats in the middle of the row as a bare text field, an unusual layout next to the stepper.
Ingredients and Steps section headers are large grey text, and the steps are plain grey numbers; the detail screen looks plain and settings-like.
The active category is visible only in the header text, not as a selected control on the list screen.
B.scroll: Scrolling feels native and smooth, with no blank or popping rows. The scroll position was kept on returning from a recipe. The scroll indicator's page count changes while scrolling (15 to 18 pages), a sign of estimated row heights, but nothing visibly jumped.

why: Both meet every requirement and both feel like native iOS lists. A is more refined: visible category chips, category icons, correct unit plurals, a clean header card and a large-text layout that stacks properly. B is solid but plainer, breaks a word with no hyphen at the largest text size, and leaves units singular when scaling ('3 cup milk').
